cmd:
STUNNEL_BIN=$(command -v stunnel4); echo "bin=$STUNNEL_BIN" && (sudo ss -tlnp | grep ':22 ' >/dev/null && echo SSHD-ON-22-OK || echo SSHD-NOT-ON-22) && sudo pkill -f stunnel4 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; sudo systemctl stop stunnel4 2>/dev/null; sudo systemctl disable stunnel4 2>/dev/null; printf 'foreground = yes
setuid = stunnel4
setgid = stunnel4
pid = /run/stunnel4/stunnel.pid
output = /var/log/stunnel4/stunnel.log
[ssh-tls]
accept = 0.0.0.0:443
connect = 127.0.0.1:22
cert = /etc/stunnel/stunnel.crt
key = /etc/stunnel/stunnel.key
' | sudo tee /etc/stunnel/stunnel.conf > /dev/null && sudo chown stunnel4:stunnel4 /run/stunnel4 /var/log/stunnel4 /etc/stunnel/stunnel.key /etc/stunnel/stunnel.crt && sudo chmod 600 /etc/stunnel/stunnel.key && printf "[Unit]
Description=stunnel TLS wrapper for SSH
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=$STUNNEL_BIN /etc/stunnel/stunnel.conf
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
" | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/stunnel-ssh.service > /dev/null && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now stunnel-ssh && sleep 4 && echo "service: $(sudo systemctl is-active stunnel-ssh)" && (sudo ss -tlnp | grep ':443 ' && echo LISTENING-443-OK || echo NOT-LISTENING) && echo "=== stunnel log ===" && (sudo tail -25 /var/log/stunnel4/stunnel.log 2>/dev/null || echo NOLOG)
note: fix stunnel startup via dedicated systemd unit
